notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Inventory:
1. Throwing out an item when dragging not on a cell
2. Double click to quickly move an item from the player's inventory to the tent and back
3. When a gun and flashlight are picked up, they are automatically placed in the quick access slots

Moving:
1. Added ability to walk sideways in a squat

Life Stats:
1. Reduced food and water consumption while sleeping
2. Ability to fall asleep even at low health value
3. Reduced chance of getting sick while eating snow
4. Food can now restore some health

notes.title: Fix bugs and updated gameplay
notes.notes:
Development of ICED VR is in full swing, we review the decisions taken earlier in terms of gameplay and if possible make changes to the original

Fixes:

 - Removed a bug in the DLS with the salvation of men

- Now the helicopter does not fly away when you signal him with a rocket

- Some players missing problems with obtaining the achievements

Changes: 

- Partially reworked system freezing, she became a little more complicated and more understandable

- Now the player needs to worry about the reserves of resources before going to bed, because in a dream they are also spent, but slower. For heating the tents are made of the lowest mode of gas flow from the burner, one full bottle = one night of heat


We will also clear the table of records, as the conditions of the gameplay have changed greatly

notes.title: Change log and news
notes.notes:
1: We have added the ability to put snow into water bottles as well as a few readjustments and balance changes. This is to make surviving easier and clearer. 

2: Fixed multiple bugs that have been reported by players. 

3: New nightmares in the form of free DLC will soon be available. 

4: UPDATE on ICED Land – We analysed the architecture of the project and concluded that we cannot implement it in the form of DLC. We are a small indie team and it would be easier to work on as a separate project.

UPD: Added support dx9

https://youtu.be/U-W_US6WiyU

notes.title: Start developing DLC ICED - Land
notes.notes: Friends, we have read all your comments and reviews, and are pleased to announce our start on a new addition that will be added to the game. The ability to play on land. This will take a lot of work and won’t happen straight away. We are very happy with the amount of support you have given us so far and we hope this continues, especially during the development process. We will have a forum available where you can share your opinions and stay up to date with the development of the DLC. Soon we will also add a demo version of ICED
